record.label: Odd-parity fanout and weak measurement in Find-Any
record.statement: The authors use odd-parity fanout to couple the $m$ query registers and extend the boundary cost coefficient to $m,k\ge2$.
record.boundary: Find-Any allows repeated addresses in its ordered tuples. The Johnson construction for Find-All uses subsets of distinct addresses. For Find-Any, Lean certifies a rational upper bound. The paper compares it with the weakly measured search coefficient $1/2+1/\pi$.
